RT ar://kemp | kempsterrrr.eth | 🫂 Ok progress on maximally decentralised @manifoldxyz galleries on Arweave Name System (ArNS) Version with hard-coded arweave(dot) links - https://manifoldtest.arweave.net/ Version using ar://wayfinder to route requests to gateways in @ar_io_network - https://wayfinder_manifoldtest.ar.io/ ☝️ one still has a few issues on it re performance and general UX, but inspect the image URLs and you'll see there all from different gateways based on network stats. Next up, using the verification features in ar://wayfinder to verify hashes of the images being served and show the verification state to the user visually. mockups attached showing roughly the direction I'm going with visual verification feature once this is all working and tided up will release an easy to use template so any @manifoldxyz creator can do this by buying an ArNS name and importing their collect contract address. Massive shout to @iamdtfiedler for this work on ar://wayfinder, it's in alpha but working beautifully @iamwhitelights get in here, also @toadswiback hope you don't mind me using your collection as an example, I thought it was dope af. if you're interested in a completely decentralised permanent gallery for your site on Arweave hmu 🙌
